world.topic:
A check of the world's host, not research.

The position that writes the report runs exactly this command once, through the world's `worlds` resource, from its repository: `researchworld run --topic probe --min-free-gb 100000`. It puts the command and its complete answer (standard output, standard error and exit status) verbatim in `report/report.md`, with one sentence saying whether a world was made. Nothing else is needed; do not run it again with other numbers.
